title: Open Components contract
description: Every requirement for a component or a convention in one file: the YAML block under a docs page's Described heading, published at https://opencomponents.dev/raw/<path>.yaml with every rule from the page's checklist. A contract with a `component` field describes a component, and any other describes a convention, like token paths.

component.title: Component contract
component.description: A component's API, its DOM contract, its tokens and its rules.
The component's name, in PascalCase, as in `Button`.

summary.description: What the component does, in a sentence or two.

standard.description: The page of the standard the contract comes from, which explains why each rule exists.

element.description: The HTML element it renders, as in `button`. A comment can name the alternative, as in `# a, with href`.

props.description: Its props, by name, in camelCase.

slots.description: Its slots, by name, with what each one holds. `default` holds the content between its tags.

events.description: The events it emits, by name, with their payload and when they're emitted, as in `MouseEvent. Never emitted while disabled.`

states.description: Its states, by name, with the selector that matches each one, as in `[aria-pressed=true]`.

keyboard.description: The keys it responds to, by name, as in `Enter`, with what each one does.

parts.description: Its parts, as marked with `data-slot`, in the order they render.

tokens.description: The CSS variables it reads, named as token paths (see https://opencomponents.dev/docs/foundations/design-tokens).

theme.description: The shared theme tokens it reads. `{color}` stands for each value of the `color` prop.

variables.description: Its own variables, which start with its name and are set on its root, as in `--button--height`.

layer.description: The cascade layer it styles itself in, out of Tailwind's order: theme, base, components and utilities.

rules.description: The page's checklist: a link to it on the page, or every rule in it, each with its layer and scope.

convention.title: Convention contract
convention.description: A convention every component follows, like token paths. Past the fields every contract has, each convention has fields of its own.
The convention's name, in kebab-case, as in `token-paths`.

summary.description: What the convention covers, in a sentence or two.

standard.description: The page of the standard the contract comes from, which explains why each rule exists.

rules.description: The page's checklist: a link to it on the page, or every rule in it.

prop.description: A prop's type, and its default value, if it has one.

type.description: A type, like `string` or `boolean`, or the values of a union, as in `[sm, md, lg]`.

default.description: The value it takes when it isn't set. For a union, one of its values.

rule.description: A rule from the page's checklist.

id.description: Its stable ID, to cite in reviews and commits, as in `button/keep-focus`.

layer.description: The layer it belongs to: the UI, or the user, developer or agentic experience.

level.description: `must` for a rule every component meets, and `should` for one that's expected unless there's a good reason not to follow it.

scope.description: Who meets it: the component, the code that uses it, or both together.

check.description: How to check it, like `Unit test`, `Review` or an axe rule.

tokenPath.description: A CSS variable named as a token path, with `-` between words and `--` between groups, as in `--color--primary-contrast`. A word in braces, like `{color}`, stands for each value of the prop it names.

schema.description: The URL of this schema, for tools that read it from the contract.
